dict.string: Remoto uses this to run the Mac actions you add to your phone's deck, like opening apps or controlling music.
Remoto turns what you say into your phone's microphone into text on your Mac. Recognition runs on this Mac, never on a server.
Remoto talks to your phone over your local network. Nothing leaves your network.
Remoto lists the apps in the folders you add, including folders on external drives.
Remoto lists the apps in the folders you add, including folders on network drives.
Remoto lists the apps in the folders you add, including folders in Documents.
Remoto lists the apps in the folders you add, including folders on the Desktop.
Remoto lists the apps in the folders you add, including folders in Downloads.
